title: ADLC persona feedback
description: One persona's walkthrough of one scenario, including the reasoning behind each step. Stored under evidence/personas/ so it is hashed as a first-class artifact. `simulated` is required and must be honest: a heuristic walkthrough and a real user session must never be indistinguishable.

scenarioId.description: Requirement or acceptance-criterion id this walkthrough exercises.

tldr.description: Plain-language outcome, sized for a card in the report.

simulated.description: true when generated deterministically from enrichment/personas.md rather than recorded from a human. Never omit and never fake.

source.description: Where this record came from: a generator name, a research tool, or a session id.

steps.description: The walkthrough in order. This is the thought process the reader came for.

artifactSha256.description: Artifacts this persona was looking at. Hash-addressed so a citation can be checked.

observation.description: What the persona saw. The state of the world before they acted.

thought.description: What they concluded and why. The reasoning a screen recording cannot show.
